model.title: Ratepayer Protection Act
model.meta: Energy and Commerce Committee · Rep. Gabe Evans (R-CO)

summary.text: The bill would amend federal utility regulation law to establish a standard allowing electric utilities to recover the full costs of infrastructure upgrades made specifically to serve large industrial or commercial customers. It aims to clarify how utilities can recoup expenses for these targeted system improvements from the businesses that directly benefit from them.
